Case Study

International Trade

Switzerland

Challenge

High volume of mixed inbound email inquiries — leads, technical questions, and noise — required manual reading, classification, and routing daily. Inconsistent handling and missed messages were a recurring problem.

What Was Built

AI classification of all inbound email into actionable categories. Automatic CRM logging. Draft response preparation for relevant inquiries. Human review and approval preserved on every outbound action.

Result

Zero emails missed or misrouted. Staff time freed from manual sorting. Human decision retained on every reply.Operational consistency achieved from day one of go-live.
